title: Routing Profiles
summary: Ready-made traffic profiles that apply a routing mode to the active transport engine and remember the active profile. The header shows the active profile and the current routing mode.

items.title: Balanced (Iran Direct + Foreign Proxy)
items.description: Applies the Iran Direct routing mode: Iranian destinations go direct and everything else through the active engine.
items.usage_tip: Recommended profile for everyday browsing. On Passwall engines a proxy node must be selected, otherwise the routing mode is refused and only the profile name is saved.

items.title: Gaming (Low latency focus)
items.description: Applies the same Iran direct mode as Balanced and saves the profile name as gaming.
items.usage_tip: No latency tuning is applied yet; keep a nearby node selected in the active engine.

items.title: Streaming (Better for video services)
items.description: Applies the same Iran direct mode as Balanced and saves the profile name as streaming.
items.usage_tip: No streaming-specific rules are applied yet; pick a fast node in the active engine.

items.title: Global Proxy (All traffic through proxy)
items.description: Applies the global mode so every destination uses the proxy.
items.usage_tip: Expect slower local access while this profile is active.

items.title: Direct Only (Disable proxy completely)
items.description: Applies direct only mode and turns proxying off on the active engine.
items.usage_tip: Use it to rule out the proxy when debugging connectivity.

items.title: Back
items.description: Returns to the Proxy & Routing Manager.
items.usage_tip: The last applied profile stays active.
